reference_policy: Public source photos used only as reference for editorial assessment; not copied into the repository or reproduced as derived photos.
qa_scope: Review of v1 900x1200 images staged in GitHub quarantine; one newer locally exported Melgaard v2 pending asset import and separate identity approval; a separate new Melgaard v3 local candidate awaiting import

entries.reason: In comparison with published Melgaard portraits, v1 has unsupported long swept-back hair, very heavy beard, decorative jacket, earrings and prominent neck tattoo; risks creating an unverified likeness.

alternative.note: New original painted illustration has shorter cropped hair and an understated jacket. Still requires verified byte import, face review and visible 'Illustrasjon' label before publishing.

additional_candidate_v3.note: A new source-informed short-haired oil-style portrait is available as a local generated candidate. It has no approved likeness or Git-tracked binary. Do not use until binary imported, visually approved and labelled.

entries.reason: Generic male illustration not verified as a recognizable portrait of photographer Stephen Butkus; must not be conflated with people who appear in photographs he made.
entries.reference_note: Styletalk credits Daniel Nærbø for photos of Stephen Butkus, but that photographer credit itself does not license photographic reuse.

entries.reason: The v1 portrait conveys an elderly white-haired collector but lacks sufficient facial similarity to be certified as Hans Rasmus Astrup (1939–2021). Do not confuse with 19th-century politician.

rejected_other_candidate.reason: An exploratory triptych mislabeled Stephen Butkus as a property developer and applied false dates to Hans Rasmus Astrup. It must never enter History Go or be used as an identification source.

require_before_activation: Authentic binary file in git matching SHA-256
Asset metadata declaring illustration not photograph
Visible 'Illustrasjon' label in actual People UI
